modmenu.summaryTranslation.orients_hotpo: A bubbling Chongqing nine-grid hotpot on a brick stove, eaten with one pair of chopsticks.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.orients_h: A bubbling Chongqing nine-grid hotpot on a brick stove: fuel the stove, seat a copper or iron pot, pour in a broth, drop ingredients into the 9x9 grid and pick them out cooked (with furnace XP) - all with one pair of chopsticks. Sitting around a burning pot slowly heals you; pick the whole pot up with its broth and food, but eating from a cold pot may make you queasy.
